summary.caption: A cinematic architectural studio scene featuring dramatic multi-plane depth with deep foreground occlusion. Photographed on an ultra-wide 24mm cinema lens stopped down to f/4.0 aperture, with critical focus locked at 1.8m on a central sculptural lounge chair. An out-of-focus brutalist fluted pillar slices into the left foreground creating organic occlusion and layered depth.

items.label: object
items.caption: A textured concrete architectural column in the extreme foreground, heavily blurred and creating partial occlusion on the left side of the frame.

items.label: object
items.caption: A razor-sharp mid-century modern lounge chair crafted in cognac leather with a brushed chrome frame, placed in perfect focus at 1.8 meters.
